text: there are a few people in the group that converted. first she needs to know which kind of conversion she wants to do (reform or orthodox) and what this will mean for her and you (in orthodox you will need to commit to lessons and living like that as well etc). in general she can contact ITIM and the international synagogue frishman/tlv. in the partner visa process she can mostly not convert on a b1 visa (some conversions have exceptions), but on a a5 visa, which means you either need to marry so she gets the a5 faster (after 6 months on b1) or she needs to wait for 3 years. use the search in the group here, there a quite a few posts about conversion.
